title: CWP/32472/2025 of SINDERPAL KAUR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 112 CWP-32472-2025 Date of decision: 11.11.2025 Sinderpal Kaur . . . . Petitioner Vs. State of Punjab and others . . . . Respondents CORAM: HON9BLE MR JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present: - Mr.Sarvesh Singla, Advocate for Mr.Chahat Goyal, Advocate, the petitioner. DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA, J. (ORAL)

1. In the present writ petition, petitioner is praying for issuance of a direction to the respondents to decide the representation dated 06.08.2025 (Annexure P7) and consider the case of the petitioner for appointment on the post of Peon under Rural Development and Panchayats Department, Punjab as per Policy for appointment on compassionate grounds dated 21.11.2002.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, on instructions from the petitioner, submits that at this stage, he will be satisfied, if a direction is given to respondent No.2 to decide the representation dated 06.08.2025 (Annexure P7) submitted by the petitioner, in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion. Chandigarh Page 1 of 2

4. Mr.Surya Kumar, AAG, Punjab accepts notice on behalf of respondents-State and does not object to the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner.

5. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, this petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to consider and decide the representation dated 06.08.2025 (Annexure P7) submitted by the petitioner within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, in accordance with law. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) 11.11.2025 JUDGE Chandigarh Page 2 of 2
